writeups: ventures/shift-roster-builder/README.md (The caller can take a later shift)
goal: Make the cheap call-out risk count closer to the slow rebuild without missing any open day, and measure what the priced pass buys with it.
notes: Diagnosis (eval/cover-risk-gap.mjs): the rebuilds that covered falsely flagged café days mostly used a swap in which the caller takes a stand-in's later shift; coverRisk forbade the caller taking any shift. Change: callerTakes (default on) in coverRisk/coverDayJoint/coverSlackPass, buildRoster option coverCallerTakes. Results: 202 person-days 72 -> 66 flagged, precision 68.1% -> 74.2%, 0 missed; retail and clinic exact. Big weeks: same moves and same time with the change on or off (A/B). Café priced: 3 zero-cost moves, exposure 100 -> 92 h, but whole-week play left more hours open (8 -> 16, 155 -> 188) with fewer changes and lower premiums, reported as a trade. Chain 3 tried: 62 flagged / 79%, but 389 s on the 60-person week, so the default stays at 2. Verification: run_venture_tests.py shift-roster-builder ok (149 s); cover-price.test.mjs 18/18; venture-preflight shift-roster-builder clean on the rerun after the fixes (exit 0).

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
